title: Min-tier-cost edge pricing implemented in three places with no shared accessor
location: app/render/assist.odin:246 + harness/assist_check.odin:92 (sim truth inline in core/routing.odin:218-223)
evidence:
core/routing.odin:218-223: "if !seen[ns] { seen[ns] = true // first (lowest-slot) pipe to this neighbor wins the representative slot min_cost[ns] = c } else if c < min_cost[ns] { min_cost[ns] = c // a fatter (cheaper) member re-prices the edge }"
app/render/assist.odin:246: "min_bundle_cost :: proc(t: ^pp.Topology, a, b: u32, cat: ^pp.Catalogs) -> i32 {"
harness/assist_check.odin:92: "check_min_cost :: proc(t: ^pp.Topology, a, b: u32, cat: ^pp.Catalogs) -> i32 {"
detail: The bundle edge-price scan (min tier cost among live pipes between a pair) now exists three times: inline in routing_rebuild, plus the two new copies. ODN-12's no-new-core-procs guard forces the copies, but a future pricing change silently desyncs the preview; only the 7-scenario preview-check pins them together.
recommended_fix: Export one accessor (e.g. render-side dag_edge_cost) and have the harness reuse it; or hoist a public core helper at the next legitimate re-bless.
